s1.quote: Stingray Deep is a section of deeper water reaching depths of up to 12 feet.

s2.quote: The sea is about 12 feet deep here, meaning that you can’t stand up. … Scuba divers can hand-feed wild stingrays with squid.

s3.quote: Stingray City lies in 12 feet of water, so is ideal for snorkellers and divers

summary.text: A North Sound dive in about 12 feet of water where wild southern stingrays gather. Reached by boat from Grand Cayman; the shallower sandbar nearby is for wading, while the deeper site is for divers and snorkellers.
